confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'the most likely cause is drive belt [belt-driven machines ONLY]'

rationale: The first reply leaked a template placeholder '[belt-driven machines ONLY]' and named the drive belt as most likely without evidence. It never asked about the belt or the carbon brushes, the most likely cause here. The stop-use escalation after the customer mentioned a faint hot smell from weeks ago is cautious and defensible. It is overly blunt, though, and it gives the customer no useful path such as checking the brushes with the power unplugged, or any thought on whether the machine is worth repairing.
